thread:
deploy-bot: Starting blue->green rollout for release v2.14 to eu-west-1 — shifting 20% traffic to green canary. Rollout ID r2-2026-03-15. Triggered at 12:34 UTC. Ping if any errors.
Maya: Seeing 502 spike on /v1/generate in eu-west canary, started ~12:36. Error rate went from ~6% to ~18% in 2m. @Priya can you take a look? :rotating_light:
Oliver: Confirming — alert fired: 5xx rate >10% for 3m. Edge latency shows bunching at POP eu-west-1-pop-3, 502s reference shard g3-12.
Priya: Paging SREs and pausing further shift. Can we flip the kill-switch flag for v2.14 in eu-west until we diagnose?
Carlos: Acknowledged. Pausing further traffic shifts now. Running rollback to blue for region. Command: `redwood deploy rollback --rollout r2-2026-03-15 --region eu-west-1 --to blue`
deploy-bot: Rollback to blue initiated for r2-2026-03-15. Targeting 0% green by 12:40 UTC. Canary rollback in progress.
Elena: Support checking customer reports — EU customers (Acme, FlyFast) reporting timeouts and token errors since ~12:35. Collecting request IDs and sample traces.
Maya: Quick check — DNS appears normal but edge routing looks inconsistent. Some POPs still sending to green despite rollback. Could be stale weights or propagation lag.
Oliver: Investigating edge config — found region-proxy eu-west-1-pop-3 weight still at 0.2 for green while others at 0.0. Looks like our config push failed for that POP. Pushing fix now.
Priya: Applying emergency feature flag kill-switch: `feature_flag.set('enable-v2-14-eu', false, rollout='global')` to force-disable green. Confirm after toggle.
Carlos: Manual fix applied to region-proxy (set weight=0.0 for green on all POPs). Also toggled feature flag off per Priya.
deploy-bot: Feature flag disable acknowledged. Traffic readback shows 0% green across eu-west-1. Monitoring metrics for stabilization for 5m.
Maya: 5xx rate dropping toward baseline. Edge logs show earlier TTL for canary DNS=60s; some clients cached IPs and kept hitting green for a short window. That explains lingering errors.
Elena: Support update: notified Acme & FlyFast of mitigation and ETA. They're asking for root cause and whether any data was exposed.
Priya: No evidence of data exposure — errors are 502/timeouts. Capturing affected request_ids and traces to hand to security if needed.
Oliver: Root cause triage: green variant included a kernel-selection patch that regressed KV cache under long sequence lengths (~seqlen 1024). Reproduced locally with replay causing 502s and cache invalidations.
Carlos: Action plan: revert kernel patch in green build, run extended canary in staging with seqlen=1024 traffic replay, add synthetic pre-rollout test for high seqlen distribution.
Maya: On-call handoff — I'm off in ~20m. @Priya can you take primary for the follow-up? I'll attach the runbook and the most recent logs to the incident ticket.
Priya: Taking over. I'll keep monitoring and created INC-2026-331 on the incident board, assigning eng-runtime for priority fix and scheduling postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-331 created (severity=P2) — https://redwood/incident/INC-2026-331.
Elena: Drafted customer comms for enterprise contacts, will send after final confirmation from eng.
Maya: Marking thread mitigated for now — root cause identified and rollback/kill-switch applied. Will add detailed notes to postmortem. :thumbsup:
